name: smwgraphics-yoshi-s-island-ds-mario-s-fleet-feet-rocks
title: Yoshi's Island DS - Mario's Fleet Feet (Rocks)
description:
It's the BG from Yoshi's Island DS, but with big changes:
-Map16 has been optimized;
-The palette for the hills go to palette 1, as it uses 5 colors. It's arranged and it doesn't overwrite the SMW palette;
-There's a free palette for layer 3 in palette 1.

Have fun using it!
